title: Zeroth Ext is Hom
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $A$ and $B$ be $R$-modules. The zeroth Ext group $\operatorname{Ext}^0_R(A,B)$ [def-pc-ext] is naturally isomorphic, as an additive group, to the group $\operatorname{Hom}_R(A,B)$ of $R$-linear maps from $A$ to $B$.
